track: recursive-interfaces (drawn); scope changed to an independent audit of PR2634 plus completion of its resumable census

original_card.question: Can one unresolved retention, output-consumer, hosting or physical-cost obligation complete a pinned QQ16 controller proposal within budget?
methods: Design and price one consumer or retained-state boundary for a pinned local decoder, including final restoration.
Audit one claimed physical invoice or prove a target-specific obstruction for its explicit retention/hosting contract.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Name the changed premise of the fixed F0/B1 observation obstruction. Show exactly which query is recovered, legal native reads and restoration, and a full favorable budget including cover maps, helpers and endpoints. Local inverse identities alone do not close the global controller. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Read the QQ16 row in research-family-status.md. The fixed-first-pair witness remains scoped; pending #2540 adds early records and claims a complete local native decoder, but not a favorable global controller. Read its output-frame and ownership contract before designing another inverse.
first_step.scope: Source-bound orientation only. Read the named package and review before relying on its local evidence; this command is not its replay or supplier admission.

original_card.first_experiment: Check live claims and pin the newest relevant completed local word (starting lead #2540). Choose one unresolved consumer, retention, whole-cover movement, hosting or precision obligation. Price the complete proposal and test that obligation; do not repeat its claimed local inverse or native reconstruction unless providing distinct independent verification.
original_card.bottleneck_link: The native local words exist; retained query information and its physical access are the missing link to a composed recursive interface.
allowed_variations: One paid query, one changed first pair, or one precisely specified affine helper state.
A counterexample or lower bound for that exact proposed repair.
One unresolved obligation of a newer local decoder, with exact source heads and a distinct claim/domain.
scope_change_triggers: Retaining the fixed first pair and ordinary schedule while allowing only homogeneous selected-only control, already excluded by the witness.
Treating cover-map counts as zero-cost physical address operations.
Recreating the pending complete local decoder or early-record/output-bank coalescing already under investigation without a distinct audit or changed premise.

actual_scope: Independent audit of PR2634 (head e2f30d93efbef5658334072aa855aa95e795e394, package research/universal-f7-singleton-l20-seed06704c39) with an independently written engine (no shared code): (1) replay the author's own verify/independent/test suites at the pinned head; (2) reproduce all 11 completed per-shard census counts exactly, including heavy shard 0102; (3) confirm mid-stream traversal agreement via capped probes, covering the label-3 prefix region no completed shard exercised; (4) independently re-derive the cover20 witness properties and the parity fact; (5) complete the remaining shards 0120, 0121, 0122, 0123 of the resumable (10,10) simple-20-cycle census at n = 7.
scope_change_reason: The chooser (OS seed fd938f301313957624c8510f1045d5e0) drew track recursive-interfaces with cards coverage-law-change / centre-path-sharing / joint-query-controller; find_overlap.py showed dense live claims and PRs on all three. Per autoresearch.md (prefer a live, unclaimed central handoff over a generic card; independent audits explicitly welcome when identified), the session took the unclaimed next step recorded in PR2634 itself ('completing the (10,10) exclusion needs several more hours of the same exact enumeration; the checkpoint is resumable') as an explicitly identified independent audit plus completion. Overlap checked: open PR list sorted by updatedAt at 2026-10-15T16:55Z showed no claim on the census remainder; claim posted in discussion 1166 before work began.
bottleneck_link: A verified finite exclusion inside the PR943 query model sharpens the recorded singleton f(7) gap (20 <= f(7) <= 24) that downstream batch bills cite. It changes no supplier, tariff or kappa and instantiates no physical interface.
smallest_falsifying_instance_first: Cross-validation gate before any new result: the independent engine had to reproduce all 11 completed shard counts exactly (including 798,901,031 / 67,674,177 / 0 on shard 0102) and the 5,000,000-node capped probes on four prefixes, before the four new shards were accepted. A depth-5 vs depth-4 internal consistency check on shard 0123 (exact cycle-sum equality; node delta exactly the 20 duplicated ancestor calls) guards against shard-initialization errors.
stop_rule: Stop at the first of: (a) any mismatch against the author's completed shard counts (audit failure, report the discrepancy), (b) a universal word found (report the witness), (c) all 15 shards complete (report totals), (d) session budget expiry with exact partial counts recorded. Outcome: (c).
evidence: AUDIT-RESULT.json records: the replayed author checks (PASS_F7_L20_VERIFY, PASS_F7_L20_INDEPENDENT, 14 tests OK); exact reproduction of all 11 completed shard counts; exact capped-probe agreement on 0102/0123/01230/01232 at 5,000,000 nodes; the four new shard counts; census totals 6,305,209,079 nodes / 597,148,314 simple 20-cycles / 0 universal words; the depth-5 consistency check; independent re-derivation of the cover20 coverage (128 masks), its degree histogram (six isolated vertices), and the parity fact. f7_census.c is the independent engine; README.md has reproduction commands and open next questions. No kappa claim; no supplier claim; the recorded gap 20 <= f(7) <= 24 is unchanged.

open_questions.question: Do repeated-state length-20 words (splits (10,9), (10,8), (9,9), (10,7)) admit a universal word?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It is now the only open family at L = 20; settling it decides whether the census step-up from PR2542 moves to L = 22.
open_questions.first_step: Extend this exact enumeration with multiset collision semantics and per-split budgets derived from lemma_a_table rows, sharded the same way.
open_questions.blocked_by: Revisit-aware prunes are weaker (self-avoidance unavailable); per-split node counts will be substantially larger and each split's collision budget must be re-derived.

open_questions.question: Is the simple (11,11) census at L = 22 feasible with the same method?

open_questions.first_step: Derive the (11,11) collision budget (C(11,2)+C(11,2)-63 = 47) and probe one depth-5 shard for its node rate.
